note: roles: (CONTEXT.md 'Role') -- publisher ships a signed, versioned artefact others pin; risk-bearer carries a declared appetite band on its OWN signed party.yaml (eco-system ticket 25 / ADR-0021 retired platform/risk/appetite.json); adopter pins and consumes another party's artefact. Roles compose -- a party may hold several -- and party.py checks every entry here against the real filesystem: this file only DECLARES, it never proves. roles here mirror each unit's signed party.yaml (platform: publisher+platform, no baseline, so not an adopter; insurer: publisher of the quote feed, first version ticket 36; driftwood is a publisher too since its twin started emitting a forward-intel feed, ADR-0021 -- which is why the institution count excludes the `platform` ROLE, not the publisher one). A publisher whose party.yaml declares publishes[] is 'declared and delegated': verify/feed-contract checks what it publishes and SKIPs until the signed tag exists, so a feed.json on a branch is never counted as a signature (ADR-0019: the tag signs).
